data.name: Purrfect Tanks - The Yarnpocalypse
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

The world’s yarn reserves are almost gone… and only the bravest (and fluffiest) feline commanders remain to fight for what’s left!

In Purrfect Tanks, you pilot a cardboard tank mounted on a loyal robot vacuum, customize your cat crew, strap ridiculous weapons to fragile cardboard armor, and dive head-first into chaotic battles for the most precious treasure of all — yarn balls. 🧶

Whether you’re blasting enemies with laser pointers, baiting them into catnip zones, or unleashing sparkly chaos with improvised cardboard weaponry, every match is a purr-fect mix of cuteness, mayhem, and stupidly fun cardboard destruction.

But be warned:
Cardboard doesn’t have a long lifespan.
Your tank will fall apart.
Again and again.
(Your cat won’t care.)

So grab your yarn, rally your feline squad, and roll into battle — before someone else claims all the fluff.

Features


🐱 Cat Commanders

Recruit brave, chaotic, constantly-distracted felines to drive your cardboard war machines.

📦 Cardboard Carnage

Your tank is made of cardboard.

Your enemies’ tanks are made of cardboard.

Everything explodes anyway.

🧶 Yarn Wars

Collect precious yarn balls before rival cats steal them.

💥 Ridiculously Wacky Arsenal

From catnip bombs to sparkle cannons and laser pointers — every weapon is cute… and surprisingly deadly.

🤖 Roomba Power

Forget tank treads.

Your robot vacuum does all the driving.

(Just don’t let it see stairs.)

😼 Catnip Frenzy Zones

Drop a catnip field and watch every cat — go absolutely feral.

🌈 Indie Charm

Cute, quirky, chaotic, and packed with more personality than a box full of kittens.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
